_meta.source: Wikimedia pageviews (CC0) for articles linked from English Wikipedia's Portal:Current_events, 2023-2024
_meta.method: 3840 articles sampled (160 per month); kept 157 whose daily views peaked at least 10x their usual level and 2000+ views; attention above the usual level divided by the peak's; median over stories per day; fitted a*0.5^(t/h1) + b*0.5^(t/h2) + c.
_meta.limits: English Wikipedia readers (worldwide but English-speaking); pageviews measure looking a story up, not knowing it.

memory.source: Meeter, Murre & Janssen (2005), Memory & Cognition 33(5):793-810, doi:10.3758/BF03193075, Table 3
memory.model: p(t) = 1 - exp(-r(t)), r(t) = mu1*(exp(-a1 t) + mu2/(a2-a1)*(exp(-a1 t) - exp(-a2 t))), t in days; share still remembered = p(t)/p(0), averaged over the three experiments (open recall questions)
